top_signals.title: Russian Crude Exports Hit Four-Month High
top_signals.summary: Russia loaded more than 30 million barrels of crude onto tankers last week as Ukrainian drone strikes forced more oil away from domestic refineries and into export markets. The 39 tankers that loaded Russian crude in the week ending November 15 carried 30.27 million barrels, up from 23.6 million barrels on 31 ships the previous week, according to Bloomberg's vessel-tracking data. Weekly exports jumped by 950,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 4.32 million bpd, the highest since June. On a four-week average, shipments reached 3.9 million bpd, their highest…
